column1: # Curated unit surfaces for English: hand-rolled, where ICU and CLDR have nothing.
# "surface" rows: a unit surface English writes that ICU writes in no English locale,
# mapped to the ICU unit it names. Only the mapping is curated: the unit, the value,
# and every expansion ("cubic centimeters") are ICU's. Each was measured in the
# "compose" rows: units ICU composes from an SI prefix that are worth building. ICU
# composes any prefix onto any unit, and some compositions are false readings (its
# centicentury is written "cc", its decibyte "dB"), so which to build is a choice.

column4: plural; ICU writes "lb" for every amount
per before the short symbol; ICU writes "/km²" or "per square kilometer"
